<section id="quickstart">
<h1>Quickstart</h1>
<section id="install">
<h2>Install</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>releaseledger
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For development:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.[dev]&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="initialize-a-project">
<h2>Initialize a project</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>init
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This creates <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.releaseledger.toml</span></code> and the default state layout:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>.releaseledger/
  ledgers/
    main/
      releases/
      events/
      indexes/
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Releaseledger is git-first. The recommended workflow uses git commit ranges
as the canonical evidence of shipped changes.</p>
</section>
<section id="create-a-release-and-attach-the-git-range">
<h2>Create a release and attach the git range</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--previous<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.1.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--released-at<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2026</span>-06-14

releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>update<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--git-base<span class="w"> </span>v1.1.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--git-head<span class="w"> </span>HEAD
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="generate-entries-from-git-commits">
<h2>Generate entries from git commits</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>git<span class="w"> </span>import<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--base<span class="w"> </span>v1.1.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--head<span class="w"> </span>HEAD<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>draft<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--output<span class="w"> </span>/tmp/1.2.0-entries.yaml
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Edit the YAML to curate summaries, then:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>entry<span class="w"> </span>add-many<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>/tmp/1.2.0-entries.yaml<span class="w"> </span>--dry-run
releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>entry<span class="w"> </span>add-many<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span>--file<span class="w"> </span>/tmp/1.2.0-entries.yaml
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="review-git-coverage-and-build-the-changelog">
<h2>Review git coverage and build the changelog</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>review<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span>--git<span class="w"> </span>--strict
releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>--strict<span class="w"> </span>--target-file<span class="w"> </span>CHANGELOG.md
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For a single release section update only:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--strict<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--target-file<span class="w"> </span>CHANGELOG.md<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--replace-existing
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="optional-taskledger-provenance">
<h2>Optional: taskledger provenance</h2>
<p>Taskledger refs (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tl:task-0103</span></code>) and PR refs (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">github:pr-42</span></code>) are optional
provenance. Add them to entries to enrich coverage, but git commits are the
primary source of truth:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>entry<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>added<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Added release bundle storage&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>accepted<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--source-ref<span class="w"> </span>git:abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--source-ref<span class="w"> </span>tl:task-0103
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="create-a-release">
<h2>Create a release</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>release<span class="w"> </span>create<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--title<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Release 1.2.0&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--boundary-ref<span class="w"> </span>tl:task-0105<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--source-ref<span class="w"> </span>tl:task-0103
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="add-entries">
<h2>Add entries</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>entry<span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>added<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--summary<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Added release bundle storage&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>accepted<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--source-ref<span class="w"> </span>tl:task-0103
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Validate entries:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>entry<span class="w"> </span>lint<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span>--strict
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="render-changelog-output">
<h2>Render changelog output</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">changelog</span></code> to produce review context:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>changelog<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--target-changelog<span class="w"> </span>CHANGELOG.md<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--release-date<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2026</span>-06-13
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build</span></code> to render and insert a final section:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--dry-run<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--strict<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--target-file<span class="w"> </span>CHANGELOG.md

releaseledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--release-date<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2026</span>-06-13<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--strict<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--target-file<span class="w"> </span>CHANGELOG.md
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
